en.hubeali:
Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ayoub, from Al Fuzayl Bin Yasaar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>:

‘The one who accepts upon himself in the presence of the Imamasws with a right of someone from the rights of the Muslims, so it is not upon the Imamasws that heasws should established the Penalty (Hadd) upon him, the one who accepted with it in hisasws presence, until the owner of the right is present, or his guardian, so he seeks his right’.
